headline: Light mode, high contrast, custom source + more
notes: [[title:Highlights]] [[new]] Light mode + High contrast. Segue isn't dark-only anymore. Pick Light, Dark or High contrast in Preferences > Appearance and the whole app restyles instantly. [[new]] Interact button. Bound by default to the button you enter races with. It stops the D-pad from skipping tracks in menus (garage, Auto Show, Return Home), then frees it when you drive off. Rebind it in settings. [[img:https://github.com/Segueapp/segue-releases/raw/main/images/1.4.0/interact_button_preview.png]] [[new]] Custom source. Use any playing app as your music source, even one that's not in the list. [[img:https://github.com/Segueapp/segue-releases/raw/main/images/1.4.0/Custom_screenshot.png]] [[new]] Combo binds. Bind two buttons pressed together as one, like LB + Square. [[img:https://github.com/Segueapp/segue-releases/raw/main/images/1.4.0/Combobinds_preview.png]] [[new]] Tap / Hold. One button, two jobs: tap to skip, hold for volume. [[img:https://github.com/Segueapp/segue-releases/raw/main/images/1.4.0/tap_hold_preview.png]] [[sub:Smaller changes]] [[improved]] Faster + cleaner. Snappier reopen, no white flash, and Space plays or pauses. [[improved]] UI polish. Smoother scrolling, restyled scrollbar, cleaner menus and update notices. [[fix]] Screensaver + sleep. Work again with a controller plugged in.
